model.title: Washington’s Trail—1753 National Historic Trail Feasibility Study Act of 2026
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. John Fetterman (D-PA)

summary.text: The bill would direct the Secretary of the Interior to study whether Washington's Trail—1753 should be designated as a national historic trail under the National Trails System Act.
